requirement: Ingest DHIS2 programme, program stage, data element, option, tracked entity attribute, indicator, category, org unit and reporting metadata by immutable revision.
Parse the configured program indicator analytics type (EVENT/ENROLLMENT), aggregation type, expression, filter, program, period boundaries and organisation-unit attribution.
Maintain a versioned support matrix for DHIS2 2.41–2.44 expression functions, constructs, variable syntax and semantics.
Reject unknown expressions and missing metadata references with actionable diagnostics; never silently return zero.
Compile valid definitions into a typed, safe internal expression AST with explicit null, numeric, date and boolean semantics.
Track dependency graphs so changed events or metadata invalidate only affected indicators/partitions.
Support local derived metrics as separately governed definitions with source, owner, rationale and version.
Expose indicator explain plans and the exact definition version used for each result.
Consume committed event, tracked entity, enrollment, relationship and approved aggregate updates from a durable change stream.
Deduplicate by immutable change identifier and source-record version and process updates exactly once in observable effect.
Apply retraction and replacement of prior contributions when an event changes, is deleted, moves period, changes org unit, or changes eligibility.
Preserve soft-deleted, quarantined, conflicted and rejected source statuses without conflating them with valid records.
Define policy for completed, active, overdue, cancelled and pending event/enrollment states per metric.
Handle concurrent capture, late-arriving data, delayed peer changes and deterministic replay after restart.
Log data-quality exceptions, parse failures, missing codes, out-of-range values and orphaned references.
Expose indicator eligibility/exclusion counts alongside reported values where privacy rules permit.
Support event count, enrollment count, distinct tracked-entity count, episodes, admissions, diagnoses, referrals, outcomes and relevant stock movement tallies as separate grains.
Support counts, filtered counts, sums, minima, maxima, means, ratios, percentages, cohort retention and validated standard deviation/variance where declared.
Define denominator-zero behaviour, missing-data treatment and rounding per metric, not by arbitrary frontend defaults.
Support repeatable stages, latest-per-enrollment selection, stage-specific event attribution and explicit temporal windows.
Prevent double-counting across service points when a clinical encounter involves multiple stages or devices.
Support standardised diagnosis grouping via governed local-to-ICD mapping and record unknown/unmapped codes separately.
Calculate all-cause and cause-specific mortality from defined death events/outcomes and cause attribution, with case-fatality defined separately.
Support multi-stage episode-derived measures such as referral completion, lab turnaround and prescription-to-dispensing times.
Mark approximate, provisional or incomplete measures explicitly and disallow publication without a configured quality gate.
Provide canonical period generators for day, week, month, quarter, half-year and year with explicit time zone and calendar rules.
Support configured DHIS2-compatible week variants and fiscal-year types only after version-specific verification.
Use half-open local instant windows [start, end) internally to avoid overlapping boundary records.
Support date-of-event, date-of-enrollment, incident date, discharge date and other approved attribution bases per metric.
Support org unit at event, enrollment, registration and authorised location rollups with explicit rules.
Provide sex, age-at-event, age-at-outcome, diagnosis, result, service point, clinic, stage, ward and programme dimensions where metadata permits.
Use governed category groupings; reject overlapping additive age bands and unknown/other omission.
Support comparable period-over-period and time-series queries including partial-period warnings.
Store versioned mappings from indicator/measure to dataElement + categoryOptionCombo + attributeOptionCombo + orgUnit + period.
Generate proposals to prefill DER Aggregate Capture rather than directly marking datasets complete.
Maintain human review, approval, source provenance, override reason and locking for regulated submissions.
Keep observed tracker-derived values and user-entered aggregate reported values separate for reconciliation.
Never duplicate sums of overlapping clinic sections or disaggregations to produce hospital totals.
Support differences against central DHIS2 analytics, dataValueSets and approved hospital submissions.
Publish only via a mapping compatible with the target DHIS2 version and stable metadata UIDs.
Provide dashboard, chart, pivot, disaggregation table, patient-safe drilldown and record detail navigation as separate views.
Support navigation hierarchy: overview > care setting > programme > stage/section > measure > dimension cell > source record when authorised.
Include filters for periods, units, programme, stage, site, service point, category/diagnosis and quality status.
Support sorting, paginated result sets, search, saved views and copy/export under per-user access controls.
Explain cell numerator, denominator, count grain, period range, included states, exclusions and last updated timestamp.
Display aggregation freshness, metadata revision, source version, completeness, sync state and reconciliation state.
Use privacy suppression and protected export for small clinical counts and identifiers.
Offer charts (trend, bar, stacked bars, line, pivot, heatmap) selected by measure/dimension semantics.
Enable scheduled/triggered site reports through authorised operational scheduling when deployed.
Apply organisation-unit and programme authorisation to the underlying query and drilldown, not solely frontend filters.
Implement row/field-level protection, purpose-based audit and export logging for personally identifiable clinical data.
Encrypt data in transit and at rest using the platform security architecture and protect analytics caches/backups.
Provide resilient queue, retry, dead-letter quarantine, replay, metrics and alerting for failed computations.
Allow recomputation following changed metadata, corrections, time-zone configuration or backfilled records.
Support tenancy isolation per site with explicit cross-site visibility only after central authorisation.
Offer incremental recomputation progress, worker capacity limits and rate-limited complex queries.
Preserve user-visible decision provenance for every aggregate cell proposed for submission.
